implementation.collision: One height-aware collider per part; Pappas bridge is elevated, not a ground-level wall; GIS combined shell is suppressed
implementation.navigation: BU_SERT_GROUND_PARTS feeds BU_GROUND_BUILDINGS for navigation, street-tree occupancy and public frontages. BU_MAP_BUILDINGS uses corresponding massing footprints with elevated passages identified separately. The former combined GSU outline is suppressed. Public passages and Mugar entrance paths join the campus guide graph; Beach-to-Marsh circulation follows the exterior of the restored STH/CAS footprint.
implementation.terrain: Shared planar foundation sampled at the Mugar south threshold, world XZ [-1329.3179982208444, 952.8118283771768], approximately 4.497 metres in the current BU DEM. Ground-level exterior walls extend down to sampled terrain, including the lower river-facing sides; the occupied floors remain planar. Forecourts and public passages follow the BU terrain lattice. A local 5.2-metre-wide, 13.9-metre-long atrium entrance ramp joins the terrain-following forecourt to the shared floor without flattening the whole courtyard. Ordinary buildings in the DEM core receive the same terrain-following foundation walls, including CAS-east at the shared Marsh entrance datum.
implementation.mobile: Same physical parts and stepped silhouettes; planar windows, reduced copings and louver/vault subdivisions; offline baking only

remainingApproximations: Redstone perimeter is registered/traced from planning drawings; it is not an as-built survey or a separately acquired current municipal polygon.
Mugar/Pappas/Link occupied-floor heights and service cores are proportional estimates; Redstone 76/98-foot heights are the explicit published figures.
Window modules and roof enclosure details follow architectural families, not one-to-one window measurements.
The local atrium entrance ramp is an authored transition between the sampled ground and modeled threshold, not a surveyed as-built accessibility design.
The model provides exterior campus circulation; it does not recreate library/classroom interiors, elevators, or accessible interior routes.
No claim that all sub-part boundaries marked surveyed are measured: surveyed identifies clipped GIS exterior rings; internal partitions were authored from the referenced plan.
